solutions.name: Sablewood Workspace Migration Factory
solutions.tagline: Microsoft 365 and file shares to Google Workspace, planned from data and run in waves.
solutions.description: Sablewood's migration service: a pre-flight audit of the legacy tenant, a wave plan by department and data complexity, personalised bilingual user comms per wave, bulk and delta transfer with go/no-go gates, post-migration validation and a daily status report for the project team and the sponsor. Runs on the Atlas migration agents (Gemini on Vertex AI Agent Engine).

audience_fit.CIO: risk, timeline, visibility — go/no-go brief and daily status
audience_fit.IT director: permissions, long paths, mobile devices, rollback — pre-flight blockers and validation
audience_fit.HR / change owner: frontline adoption and language — personalised comms

how_it_works: User comms in English and Spanish (Atlas User Comms)
Bulk transfer and delta sync with go/no-go gates (Atlas Core Data Mover, Atlas Delta Sync)
Validation and daily status (Atlas Post-Migration Validator, Atlas Status Reporter)

solutions.name: Sablewood Idea-to-Demo Sprint
solutions.tagline: A one-line idea becomes a clickable prototype and a draft SOW outline in one working session.
solutions.description: Sablewood's discovery offering: a builder designs the core user journey and renders a self-contained clickable prototype on synthetic data, a critic checks it against the concept, and the session ends with a draft SOW outline — phases, deliverables and an estimate range from an illustrative rate card. Runs on the Morpheus agent (Gemini on Vertex AI).

audience_fit.Innovation lead: speed from idea to something clickable

solutions.name: Sablewood AI Guardrail Service
solutions.tagline: Every outbound model call screened for personal data, secrets and prompt injection — and runaway spend stopped.
solutions.description: Sablewood's managed guardrail for clients running AI agents: a deterministic pre-check redacts personal data with typed tokens, blocks secrets and injection attempts and compares each agent's hourly spend with its baseline. In production the verdicts are enforced by Model Armor templates and Sensitive Data Protection on the Vertex AI call path. Runs on the Aegis agent.

audience_fit.CIO / CISO: data leakage, prompt injection, audit trail

how_it_works: PII redaction, secret and injection detection

solutions.name: Sablewood Meeting Intelligence
solutions.tagline: Every client meeting becomes knowledge, alerts, tasks and a churn signal.
solutions.description: Sablewood's meeting-intelligence agents for professional-services and B2B teams: recorded meetings become searchable knowledge records, each meeting is scored for dissatisfaction, scope creep and disengagement with verbatim evidence, action items become owned and dated tasks, and an explainable churn-risk score per account drives the save plan. Runs on the Janus, Helios, Athena and Oracle agents.
